fred return shapes

Source: R/types_fred.R
fred_shapes.Rd

Reusable roxyassert @type shapes for the parsed fred data.tables. Measurement columns (a published statistic value) are typed | NA; structural columns (ids, dates, real-time-window bounds) are strict. fred is a leaf connector: nothing internal calls a per-shape validator and no downstream package validates against these shapes, so there is no @genassert and no @exportassert; the shapes exist only to be expanded into each method's own return contract.
